channel.title: Treasure Coast Today
channel.description: Local news for Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties, Florida.

item.title: Martin County faces $2.1 billion transportation funding gap as needs outpace available money
item.description: Martin County is facing a $2.1 billion transportation funding shortfall, and the gap between what the county needs and what it can afford could shape how residents get around for decades.

item.title: Lightning strikes ignite brush fire and house fire in Port St. Lucie
item.description: Friday's severe weather brought heavy lightning activity to Port St. Lucie, sparking fires that required emergency response.

item.title: St. Lucie County woman wins $5 million on $20 scratch-off ticket
item.description: Maria Duran of St. Lucie County claimed a $5 million top prize from a scratch-off game purchased at a Fort Pierce store.

item.title: Waterspout passes over Indian River Lagoon near Sebastian during Friday storms
item.description: Severe weather on Friday produced a large waterspout over the Indian River Lagoon that was captured on video by multiple residents.

item.title: West Palm Beach VA Healthcare System holds resource fair at Big Dog Ranch Rescue in Loxahatchee
item.description: The VA hosted a resource fair for veterans on Friday, offering enrollment assistance and health care services at the Loxahatchee facility.

item.title: Boynton Beach Fire Rescue saves dog that fell into raw sewage lift station
item.description: A specialized confined space rescue operation was launched Thursday after a dog fell roughly 10 to 12 feet into a lift station containing raw sewage.

item.title: Boca Raton man arrested for soliciting videos from minor in Boynton Beach
item.description: Maximiliano Buitrago, 51, was arrested after allegedly responding to an undercover post and asking a 14-year-old for videos.

item.description:

item.title: JetBlue ending Vero Beach to JFK route in September due to low demand
item.description: JetBlue is canceling its flight route between Vero Beach Regional Airport and New York's JFK Airport, with the last flights operating on Sept. 9. item.title: St. Lucie County woman claims $5 million scratch-off jackpot from Fort Pierce store
item.description: Maria Duran, 57, turned a $20 scratch-off ticket into a $5 million top prize from the $5,000,000 CROSSWORD CASH game.

item.title: Britain's Josh Kerr breaks mile world record with 3:42.66 time in London
item.description: Josh Kerr ran the mile in 3:42.66 at a Diamond League event in London on Saturday, breaking Hicham El Guerrouj's 27-year-old world record of 3:43.13 set in 1999.

item.title: Argentina defeats England 2-1 in World Cup semifinal with late comeback goals
item.description: Argentina rallied from a 1-0 deficit with goals from Enzo Fernandez and Lautaro Martinez in the final minutes to beat England 2-1 and advance to the World Cup final against Spain.

item.title: MLB restricts dugout iPad use to prevent teams from using AI for in-game decisions
item.description: Major League Baseball made custom tabs on dugout iPads inaccessible starting Wednesday night to prevent teams from using artificial intelligence to make decisions about substitutions, pitch calling, and other in-game choices.

item.title: Photographer captured images of Messi bathing Yamal as baby in 2007, now they meet in World Cup final
item.description: Joan Monfort photographed teenage Lionel Messi bathing infant Lamine Yamal in 2007 for a charity calendar. The two will face each other Sunday when Argentina plays Spain in the World Cup final.

item.title: Security ramped up for World Cup final in New Jersey with Secret Service perimeter for Trump attendance
item.description: Federal agents, local law enforcement, and private companies have implemented a security plan two years in the making for Sunday's World Cup final, with enhanced measures including a Secret Service perimeter because President Trump will attend.

item.title: Flip City gymnasts from Treasure Coast earn national top 15 finish, qualify for Junior Olympics
item.description: Three gymnasts from Flip City Gym and Cheer secured a top 15 finish at AAU Nationals in Knoxville, Tennessee last month, qualifying them for the Junior Olympics in Iowa next month.
